articles.title: Bigfoot Is Back on the Big Screen — and This Time He's Bringing Secrets
articles.summary: A new movie called 'Capturing Bigfoot' comes out October 20 — National Bigfoot Day! It's about a famous 59-second film from 1967 that people still argue about. The movie has never-before-seen footage that might change everything.

articles.title: 33 Years Ago, 'The X-Files' Told Us the Truth Was Out There — and We Believed It
articles.summary: On September 10, 1993, 'The X-Files' premiered and changed sci-fi TV forever. It followed two FBI agents — one who believed in aliens, one who didn't — and made 'Trust no one' a famous catchphrase.

articles.title: Wait, Where's the iPhone 18? Apple Skipped It This Fall
articles.summary: Apple just announced new iPhones — but not the regular iPhone 18! Instead, we got the foldable iPhone Duo and the iPhone 18 Pro. The standard iPhone 18 might arrive next spring. Fans are a little confused.
